messages:
maya_a (AE): FYI NovaBank sent enterprise auth requirements. POC kickoff tomorrow. Main asks: Okta SAML, SCIM group sync, RBAC, domain allowlist, audit logs. Need runbook + pricing diff for Dedicated vs Hosted+VPC.

carlos_it (NovaBank): Confirming: NameID=email persistent, group-based role assignment via SCIM. Can Redwood map SCIM groups to roles and disable self-signup?

maya_a (AE): @carlos_it yes. @tom_se can you list POC steps and metadata we need from their IdP?

tom_se (Solutions Eng): POC checklist:
1) SAML metadata XML or SSO URL + cert.
2) SCIM base URL + token (test mode).
3) Desired group->role mapping.
4) Test accounts (admin/manager/user).
5) Expected load for sizing.
Also clarify JIT vs SCIM-only. If RBAC depends on groups, SCIM push preferred.

carlos_it (NovaBank): We'll use SCIM group push, JIT disabled. Sharing metadata + token today.

priya_sec (Security): Security notes:
- We support signed SAML assertions; encryption optional (available for Private).
- SCIM over TLS; recommend token rotation.
- Hosted default audit retention 90d; Dedicated/Private can extend.
Please have customer complete the security questionnaire (link in workspace). Need KMS preference (they requested AWS CMK).

maya_a (AE): @priya_sec noted. I'll add questionnaire to workspace.

sam_fin (Finance): Pricing snapshot: Hosted+VPC PAYG lower commit (~$8-10k/mo est). Dedicated (reserved GPUs + SLA + 1yr retention) around ~$18k/mo. 1yr log retention add-on ~+$2k/mo. I'll prepare comparison.

deploy-bot: Created POC workspace: workspace-novabank-17825 (link in console).

tom_se (Solutions Eng): SCIM mapping example for Okta->Redwood RBAC:
```
scim.mapping = {
  "groups": {
    "okta:Engineers": "role:engineer",
    "okta:Admins": "role:admin"
  },
  "user": {
    "email": "emails[0].value",
    "name": "profile.firstName + ' ' + profile.lastName"
  }
}
```
For SAML request SSO URL, Entity ID, x509 cert, NameID format (we support email/persistent).

carlos_it (NovaBank): Also need domain-only signup (block other domains). Can Redwood enforce allowlist?

priya_sec (Security): Yes — domain allowlist and block social signups. Hosted customers get policy controls; Private gets customer-managed directory options. We'll document enforcement choices in the questionnaire follow-up.

maya_a (AE): Action items:
- Carlos: upload Okta metadata + SCIM token + map (today).
- Tom: deliver POC runbook and test plan EOD.
- Priya: attach security checklist and confirm KMS flow.
- Sam: pricing comparison for Dedicated vs Hosted+VPC (tomorrow).

carlos_it (NovaBank): Uploading now, will ping. Thanks. :pray:

tom_se (Solutions Eng): I'll draft runbook in the workspace with test cases: SAML login pass/fail, SCIM sync, RBAC enforcement, audit export.

maya_a (AE): Sending calendar invite for 10:00 PDT kickoff tomorrow.

last message: carlos_it (NovaBank) uploaded metadata and confirmed calendar.
